content: whoamiMy name is Mathilde and I’m a former illustrator 🎨 now working in information security. Computers always attracted me (I discovered and used Ubuntu for the first time at age 12 🤓). Thanks to School 42, a free-tuition computer programming school in Paris, I could make a bold career change and become an OSINT tools developer! Strange but true: I enjoy writing parsers. 💙 I love CTI, OSINT/investigative journalism, recreational pentesting (Portswigger Web Academy, Root Me) CTFs, and especially learning new things (currently focusing on reverse engineering). Besides computers and infosec, I like reading/watching SciFi (N.K. Jemisin, R.F. Kuang, Becky Chambers, Rivers Solomon), sometimes horror (Mariana Enriquez), martial arts, growing plants and painting. One of my paintings. Thinking about starting a series. 💭
